_comment: Third-party attribution inventory for rdc. Mirrors private/renet/pkg/embed/credits.go for the embedded-binary entries (asset/name/version MUST match; enforced by scripts/check-embed-credits.ts against private/renet/Dockerfile ARGs) and additionally records the SEA-bundled Node.js runtime and the bundled npm dependencies. Source of truth read in dev; embedded as a SEA asset for release builds.
gplWrittenOffer: This distribution conveys GPL-licensed binaries (CRIU, rsync). The exact corresponding source for each is retrievable at the source URL listed for that component. Rediacc will additionally mirror each exact-version source archive at the recorded releases.rediacc.com path. Written requests for source may be sent to legal@rediacc.com.

components.name: CRIU
components.license: GNU General Public License, version 2 (some libraries LGPL-2.1); conveyed as an unmodified binary, invoked via exec.

components.name: csi-provisioner (kubernetes-csi/external-provisioner)
components.license: Apache License 2.0 (Copyright The Kubernetes Authors); conveyed as an unmodified upstream binary, run as a host process in --node-deployment mode (spec 09 §1), invoked as a subprocess. Apache-2.0 s4 attribution retained.

components.name: csi-snapshotter (kubernetes-csi/external-snapshotter)
components.license: Apache License 2.0 (Copyright The Kubernetes Authors); conveyed as an unmodified upstream binary, run as a host process in --node-deployment mode (spec 09 §1/§6), invoked as a subprocess. Apache-2.0 s4 attribution retained.
components.notes: One upstream source archive (external-snapshotter) builds BOTH csi-snapshotter and snapshot-controller; the embedded VolumeSnapshot v1 CRDs (pkg/kube/csidriver/crds) are vendored verbatim from the same v8.6.0 tag.

components.name: k3s
components.license: Apache License 2.0 (Copyright The k3s Authors / SUSE); conveyed as an unmodified upstream binary (the single static k3s release binary, not the airgap images tarball), invoked as a subprocess. Apache-2.0 s4 attribution retained.
components.notes: k3s ships no top-level NOTICE file in its release archive as of this version; the Apache-2.0 LICENSE and this attribution satisfy s4. The binary vendors third-party components (containerd, runc, CoreDNS, etc.) under their own licenses, catalogued in the k3s source tree.

components.name: rclone
components.license: MIT License (Copyright (C) 2012 by Nick Craig-Wood); conveyed as a binary.

components.name: rsync
components.license: GNU General Public License, version 3 or later; conveyed as a binary, invoked via exec.
components.notes: Built from unmodified upstream source (statically). The 3.4.1-era LinuxFromScratch security_fix patch is no longer applied — 3.4.4 already carries those fixes upstream.

components.name: snapshot-controller (kubernetes-csi/external-snapshotter)
components.license: Apache License 2.0 (Copyright The Kubernetes Authors); conveyed as an unmodified upstream binary, run as the CP-node cluster singleton with --enable-distributed-snapshotting (spec 09 §6), invoked as a subprocess. Apache-2.0 s4 attribution retained.

components.name: zot
components.license: Apache License 2.0 (Copyright The Zot Authors); conveyed as an unmodified upstream binary (full build, with the sync extension), invoked as a subprocess. Apache-2.0 s4 attribution retained.
components.notes: This is the FULL zot build (zot-linux-<arch>), NOT the -minimal variant. Do not 'optimize' to the minimal build: the pull-through cache depends on the sync extension (sync.onDemand), and zot compiles extensions ONLY into the full binary. The minimal build is distribution-spec-only and cannot mirror upstreams, which defeats the entire purpose (D8).

components.name: Node.js
components.license: MIT License, plus the licenses of its bundled components (V8, OpenSSL, and others). The rdc release binary is a Node.js Single Executable Application: the Node.js runtime is embedded.

components.name: npm dependencies (bundled)
components.license: The rdc JavaScript bundle links its production npm dependencies. Their individual licenses and versions are enumerated in the THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES file bundled with release builds (rdc credits --licenses).
